items.q: And I remember him, oh he and I had some wonderful discussions at the Band Box, the Rhythm Club, and we were on several other record dates, I just forget. But I do remember the ones that we did with Jelly Roll

ctx.x: That's right, and he was a very good trumpet player. And I remember him, oh he and I had some wonderful discussions at the Band Box, the Rhythm Club, and we were on several other record dates, I just forget. But I do remember the ones that we did with Jelly Roll, and I liked his playing very much. Ward Pinkett, he died quite young.
